simulation.title: Polling Simulation
simulation.subtitle: Experience the voting journey step by step.

1.title: Before You Vote
1.instruction: Check your name in the electoral roll and keep your voter ID ready.

2.title: Find Your Booth
2.instruction: Locate the correct polling booth using your constituency and booth slip.

3.title: Arrive at the Booth
3.instruction: Reach early, follow the queue, and stay calm as polling begins.

4.title: Identity Verification
4.instruction: Show your ID to the polling officer and confirm your name in the register.

5.title: Cast Your Vote
5.instruction: Use the EVM carefully and verify the VVPAT slip before leaving the machine.

6.title: After Voting
6.instruction: Listen for the indelible ink mark, collect guidance, and exit the booth respectfully.

7.title: Counting Day
7.instruction: Learn how votes are counted transparently under Election Commission supervision.

8.title: Certificate & Celebration
8.instruction: Download your completion certificate and share your civic achievement.
